title: Kernel command index
description: Shape of schema/cli/commands.json: one record per kernel command. The join key to the spec openspec/specs/kernel-cli/<group>/spec.md is `id`: the command's requirement heading is `### Requirement: bdk <argv...>` and `id` is argv joined by "-". T11 generates --help from these records and asserts that every id has a handler or a kernel/not-implemented stub; the hooks pre-tool guard reads `availability` from the same file.

base.description: Common rules that are not repeated in each command's `refusals`. A command's full rule set is refusals + base.all (unless standalone) + base.changeScoped (when changeScoped); its `exits` follow from the classes of that set.

all.description: Rules every command may emit: dispatcher and runtime checks.

changeScoped.description: Rules every Change-scoped command may emit: no active Change and the state checks.

argv.description: Group, optional verb, optional sub-verb (spec delta check).

slice.description: Kernel module that owns the command (contract section 9).

owner.description: Plan task that implements the command.

since.description: Kernel version that introduced the command, when later than 3.0.0.

changeScoped.description: The command resolves the active Change from the branch and may emit base.changeScoped rules.

standalone.description: The command runs without a project root, git or the Node minimum, so base.all does not apply (only `version`).

name.description: `<placeholder>` for a value, a bare word for a positional discriminator whose literals are in `values`.

values.description: Allowed literals for a positional discriminator.

value.description: Placeholder for the flag's value; absent for boolean flags.

flags.description: Command-specific flags. --json and --help are implicit on every command.

stdin.description: What the command reads from stdin, when it does.

output.description: JSON Schema of the --json success output, relative to schema/cli/. Several commands may share one schema (ctx skill|role|startup share output/ctx.json; version uses common/version.json).

exits.description: Derived: 0 plus the exit code of every rule class in the command's full rule set; [0] for inject mode, [0, 2] for guard mode.

refusals.description: Command-specific rules only; the common rules live in `base`.

writes.description: Change directory, working tree or configuration paths the command may write, and `git:commit` when it creates a commit; empty for read commands (T14 cross-check).
